A1.justification: Both readable 19-page PDFs describe the same work and support direct comparison of all included text, equations, figures, and tables. Neither contains an appendix or embedded supplement, despite both referring to an Appendix in Section 4.1.

before.justification: v2 reports original navigation results, component ablations, dataset-quality measurements, and simulated and real-world demonstrations in Section 4, Tables 2–4, and Figures 4–6.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, dataset-quality measurements, and deployment demonstrations reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same StreamVLN backbone, Instruction Progress Anchoring, SAM-based Memory Landmark Anchoring, training objectives, and two-stage training procedure.

E1.justification: Table 1 retains the same training sources and synthesized datasets. Evaluation still covers R2R-CE, RxR-CE, and the same real-world robot scenario; no task or domain is added.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains every comparator, including StreamVLN, DualVLN, NaVID, and Uni-NaVID. Table 4 retains the same visual-prompting and random-sampling controls. The newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The validation-unseen splits, navigation metrics, two ablation training settings, trajectory-length bins, and real-world deployment protocol are unchanged. Citation renumbering does not alter experimental settings.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same component ablations in Table 3, trajectory-length analysis in Figure 5, dataset-quality comparisons in Table 4, and qualitative cases in Figures 4 and 6.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests. The tables and plots retain the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: All reported result entries and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 2 retains the proposed method's R2R-CE SR/SPL of 65.6/62.1 and RxR-CE SR/SPL of 61.7/53.3; the ablation, trajectory-length, and dataset-quality results also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, temporal-ordering constraint, spatial-query construction, and Equations (1)–(5) are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or substantive mathematical revision is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same state-drift diagnosis, dual-anchoring contributions, dataset contributions, and claims about benchmark performance and long-horizon robustness.

C2.justification: The explanations of progress drift, memory drift, complementary component benefits, and real-world generalization remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The disclosed backbone, AdamW learning rate of 1e-5, 32 H200 training GPUs, and robot deployment hardware are unchanged. Both retain the future code/data-release promise and the reference to an appendix absent from the supplied files.

R1.justification: v4 adds three references: SpaAct and Think Before Go in the introduction, and MORN in Section 2.2. Existing references are retained and renumbered. These are limited citation additions without expanded comparative discussion or changed novelty claims.

P1.justification: v4 adds equal-contribution markings for Kailin Lyu and Xi Lin, an Xpeng affiliation for Jinjun Wang, and a funding acknowledgement. It also replaces placeholder running titles with the paper title. Scientific prose and section organization remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block, running headers, acknowledgement, and expanded bibliography produce limited layout changes. All six figures and four tables retain their content, structure, captions, and placement, apart from citation renumbering.

improvement.justification: v4 provides modest editorial polish and additional attribution and citations, but leaves the scientific exposition, experimental evidence, conclusions, and reproducibility information unchanged. The same unresolved appendix reference remains. These administrative and cosmetic updates do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
